full_judgment: "Every C.S. Plot or R.S. plot or S.A. plot under the land laws, as depicted in the survey maps represent a separate entity, clearly identifiable in a holding recorded in a khatian. If more than one plot of land arc transferred by a sale deed a tenant having land contiguous to one of the plots, cannot lay his claim of pre-emption beyond that plot, because, the contiguity cannot be stretched to other plots. This proposition would not only be in full agreement with the different provisions of section 96, but also in conformity with the very object of the legislation."
